description: This file defines the main application component for a Tic Tac Toe game built with React Native. It manages game state, user interactions, AI moves, and renders various UI components such as the game board, controls, header, and status card.

methods.name: createEmptyBoard
methods.description: Returns an initial empty game board, an array of nine nulls representing empty cells.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game, clearing the board and setting the current player to 'X'.

methods.name: handlePressCell
methods.description: Handles user tapping a cell to make a move if conditions permit.

methods.name: handleToggleMode
methods.description: Switches game modes (PvP or PvC) and resets the game state accordingly.

methods.name: handleNewGame
methods.description: Starts a new game by resetting the board and related state.
